brief: Kirby, A calculus for framed links in S³ (Invent. Math. 45, 35–56, 1978) — the two moves generating equivalence of framed-link surgery presentations of a 3-manifold.
extended:
**A Calculus for Framed Links in S³** — Robion Kirby. Inventiones mathematicae 45, 35–56 (1978).

A framed link L in S³ is a finite disjoint collection of smoothly embedded circles, each with an integer framing. The paper gives the calculus — the moves — under which two framed links yield the same 3-manifold by surgery, so that 3-manifold invariants can be defined by checking invariance under those moves alone.

**Why it may bear here.** Kirby calculus is the move-invariance that every surgery-presented quantum 3-manifold invariant in this library rests on (the Reshetikhin–Turaev, Ohtsuki and WRT material). Foundational rather than directly cited.
